summary: All three assemblies fail physical verification. Jabra shows facing flip and orbit penetration/floating of external earbuds with estimated scale. Charger shows orbit gap: adapter unplugged and static cable detached, hiding behind source overlap; cable is not deformable simulation. Wallet shows distant separated parts, floating with no ground, missing flap, private diagnostic only. Display limited to illustrative source-camera samples with orbit diagnostics and unknown scale/contact/function disclaimers.
